title: Hebereke's Popoitto
overview:
Sizzling Versus Action!!

Wowwww! Wheeee! The ultimate puzzle game, starring the eight unique Hebereke characters! Play against the computer or take on a friend for non-stop Hebereke fun!

Hebereke has wandered into a strange world and must find his way home. Colored Popoons drop into the well in pairs - steer and rotate them to line up four or more of a color and clear them. Each stage is cleared by wiping out all of the Poroporos, preplaced blocks that can slide around the field, before the stack reaches the top. Flashing Almighty Popoons match any color.

- One player: travel through eight stages and recruit each character you beat
- Two players: best-of-three battles where chain reactions dump extra Popoons on your rival, with five handicap levels
- Options for difficulty, a free-form clearing rule and diagonal moves
